units.source_text: 兴之所至，便把久不染指的七弦琴从囊中取出，随意弹奏一曲。

en.t: Moved by a sudden impulse, he took from its case the seven-stringed zither he had not touched for so long, and casually played a piece.

units.source_text: 左右诸人听了，都伤心感怀，悲不自胜。

en.t: When the people around him heard it, they were all overcome with sorrow and feeling, unable to bear their grief.

units.source_text: 源氏公子又使尽平生秘技，弹一曲《广陵散》。

en.t: Prince Genji then brought out all the secret skill he had mastered in his life and played a piece called Guangling San.

units.source_text: 那山边内宅里的多情善感的青年女子，听见琴声和着松声随风飘来，都深深地感动。

en.t: The tender and sensitive young women in the inner rooms by the mountain heard the sound of the zither mingling with the pines and drifting on the wind, and they were all deeply moved.

units.source_text: 岂但如此，连各处无知无识的衰朽庶民，也都走到海边来迎风倾听，因而伤风咳嗽。

en.t: Nor was that all: even the ignorant, worn-out common people from every place came down to the shore to listen into the wind, and so caught colds and began to cough.

units.source_text: 明石道人闻此琴声，也忍不住了，便抛舍了三宝供养，走来听赏。

en.t: When the Akashi monk heard the zither, he too could no longer restrain himself; he abandoned his offerings to the Three Treasures and came over to listen and enjoy it.
